text: Yes, tree-cover loss occurred on this asset in 2023. About 0.7 hectares (1.2% of the asset) of tree cover was lost, as detected by the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset. The loss was corroborated by the JRC 2020 forest reference map, which confirmed forest cover in the area before the event. However, the evidence does not specify whether this was deforestation (e.g., illegal clearing) or another type of stand-replacing change (e.g., harvesting a plantation). The asset is a rural property of 58.1 hectares in a mixed territorial context.
